turns.question: By what percentage did our ad spend grow in the week of 14 September 2026 over the week before?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no ad-spend growth metric (week-over-week growth exists only for leads, bookings and revenue), so I can't give a percentage; the closest is Ad spend (EUR), which was EUR 1,500.00 for the week starting 14 September 2026 (14-20 Sep) and EUR 1,415.00 for the week starting 7 September (7-13 Sep). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
